 Hawkeye Preview: Intel on Northwestern from the Zach Koons of the Bleav in Northwestern podcast 
 The Hawkeyes and Wildcats will kick off at Ryan Field Saturday just after 6:30 PM. By KCRG Staff Published : Nov. 6, 2026 at 3:34 PM CST | Updated : 17 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google IOWA CITY, Iowa (KCRG) - Ahead of Iowa’s week 10 matchup with Northwestern, TV9’s Jack Lido sat down with Zach Koons of the Bleav in Northwestern podcast and Sports Illustrated to discuss the keys to the game.
 The Hawkeyes and Wildcats will kick off at Ryan Field Saturday just after 6:30 PM.
